body.x: Judging by my experience from the past 16years of visiting tech exhibitions in major cities (MWC in Barcelona, ​​IFA inBerlin, CEBIT in Hannover, Germany), CES is definitely a showcase.

When assessing the level of world classexhibits, it's a bit of a hiccup to look at the size of the showroom, but ifyou only take the hardware to scale, the CEBIT Hannover Exhibition Center isprobably the biggest in the world. That does not mean that the CES exhibitionis small.

The exhibition space is 2.5 million square feet, about 70,000 square meters. Maybe you will be able to see it all day long without having to rest for four days. Moreover, because the venue is scattered around Las Vegas Convention Center (LVCC) in a few places, the size actually felt will be even bigger.

CES is different in many respects. The term'different dimension' has several meanings. Of course, the external appearanceshould also be differentiated, but what is implied in it means that it is very'high'. (Here, 'level' means a more emotional approach than a rationalperspective)

Above all, CES is a space where agendas andkeywords are created to lead the world in 'that year + future' at the beginningof the new year. And CES is the first space in the world where people'screative thoughts and challenges to the impossible, and all kinds of desiresare realized as technology and products.
Keywords such as 'technology', 'product',and 'innovation' are somewhat barren and stiff, but in reality, CES is a placewhere you can experience 'anthropology' and 'humanities' in three dimensions.

If you look at the technology and productsthat are exhibited at the CES exhibition hall, you can realize how great humanbeings are. In that sense, I think the Bible passage that defines"human" specifically is very accurate. Bible Genesis 1:27 is definedas "The Image of God," which says that God created the "humanbeing at the level of God" that resembles himself. Yes, human beings arecreated at the level of 'God', so humans can develop technologies and productsthat go far beyond imagination.

Let's experience the infinite challenges ofhumans created in the image of God through CES. Experience how the human beingis performing a revolution that transforms impossible to possible, changeshistory, and recreates time and space. CES, where people can experience andfeel how their thoughts and desires are born as marvelous technologies andproducts.

Stone Age - Bronze Age - Iron Age - Digital Age ... Although future generations will record human history as such, only those who live in this age can experience the great process of the Era (Iron Age The process of moving to the digital age).
Looking around CES is a lucky day ofwitnessing such a huge change in human history. Would you like to board a spaceship to the future world a little?

On the other hand, CES 2019 focuses on how technologydevelops, protects and restores the environment in which humans live, and howhuman-developed technologies contribute to and contribute to the existingproblems of human society.

There are many problems or new problems inthe global village. The problem of unequal economic development betweencontinents and countries, the poverty problem, the problem of natural disasterscaused by climate change and the safety problems of humans, the environmentalpollution problems such as air and soil and water by industrialization andurbanization, The human society has a lot of problems to solve, such ashealthcare problems to solve and prevent diseases, job problems to beeliminated by AI and robots, and control and prevention of crime and humansuffering.

You will find the solutions, ideas andinspirations you need to solve the problems of human society in the stage ofCES. This is because world-class companies' technologies and products, keynotesand conferences with world-class experts, and hundreds of innovative start-upswill provide a wide variety of 'sources' of insight.

※ I have been producing CES documentaries every year for several years. I also plan to produce a video on CES2019 for 50-60 minutes. Of course, you can do all of your production by yourself on your own smartphone. The reason for making a documentary on smartphone was to use it as lecture (educational use) material.

I think that it is best to present the vividscene with visual images in the flow of global industry, knowledge of newtechnology or new product, and information transmission. By doing it all byyourself, you can save on production costs. Generally, if you make 50 ~ 60minute documentary, you have to invest a lot of manpower and cost from planningstage to production completion.
I make a documentary for those who cannotget on the ship to the future world, but I hope there is a lot of opportunityto show it.
KIDAI KIM
Editor & USA Correspondent
